title: From computational ethics to morality: how decision-making algorithms can help us understand the emergence of moral principles, the existence of an optimal behaviour and our ability to discover it
reasoning: The paper is centered on the formalization of morality and ethical principles. It utilizes Reinforcement Learning and Markov Decision Processes as mathematical metaphors to investigate the existence and discoverability of objective ethical principles, drawing on concepts from consequentialism, utilitarianism, and evolutionary ethics.
